# TP-Link Kasa EP10

Read status and control relay or LED state on compatible TP-Link Kasa EP10 plugs through Muse Home Link, using the confirmed legacy IOT local TCP protocol (commonly port 9999, python-kasa legacy client, XOR-autokey JSON framing). The legacy interface needs no account credentials. The EP10 has no energy metering and does not use the EP25 authentication path.
